blocks.text: The coronation crown of Maro, said to have gone down with the king's barge in [[The Drowning War]]. Sailors' tales give it a new resting place every winter; salvage guilds have dredged half the gulf chasing them.

It is not regalia — it is the *key*. The crown is the instrument that called the sea onto Maro, and it opens the inner seal of the [[Undercrypt of Maro]]. [[Brother Aldous]] dropped it into the gulf from the shrine pier, and only he knows where.
